title: yosoi::action::run_module_from_root_with_export
signature: pub fn run_module_from_root_with_export(root: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>, entry: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>, export_name: impl Into<String>) -> Result<yosoi::flow::Step, yosoi::action::JavaScriptModuleError>
docs:
Snapshots an entry module under an explicit filesystem root and selects a
default or named export to return as JSON after evaluation. The export is
read, never invoked.
